vopros: Who in the US can get ChatGPT to name my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
If by “get ChatGPT to name my company” you mean getting your company mentioned when someone asks ChatGPT something like “What are the best companies for X?” or “Who provides X in Los Angeles?”, there are two distinct routes in the U.S.:

- Organic mentions: No person or agency can legitimately buy placement inside ChatGPT’s answers. OpenAI says ads do not influence or alter answers. For product businesses, you can improve eligibility for discovery by supplying accurate product data through OpenAI’s commerce systems; Shopify merchant catalogs are already integrated, while other merchants can apply to provide product feeds. ([help.openai.com](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/11128490-improved-shopping-results-from-chatgpt-search?utm_source=openai))
- Paid placement: ChatGPT Ads are now available. U.S. businesses can use OpenAI’s Ads Manager or work through agency partners including Dentsu, Omnicom, Publicis, and WPP, plus technology partners such as Adobe, Criteo, Kargo, Pacvue, and StackAdapt. Ads are clearly separated from ChatGPT's answer, however—they don't make ChatGPT recommend your company in the answer itself. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/new-ways-to-buy-chatgpt-ads/?utm_source=openai))

There’s also an emerging industry usually called GEO/AEO (“generative engine optimization” / “answer engine optimization”). Agencies can work on making your company more discoverable and better represented in the public sources ChatGPT may consult, but they cannot guarantee that ChatGPT will name you.

If you tell me what your company sells and its website, I can identify specific U.S. agencies/vendors that specialize in getting brands discovered in ChatGPT and compare their services.
